name: Public site loads Firebase content
description: Verifies the public site can render with Firebase-backed content and its built-in fallbacks.
steps: Open the Wycliffe Studios home page
Wait for the page content to load
expected: The hero, services, pricing, portfolio, and contact sections are visible.

name: Admin signs in with Firebase
description: Verifies the admin route presents a Firebase email/password login.
steps: Open the Admin link in the footer
expected: The Wycliffe Studios admin login shows email and password fields.

name: Quote request saves a lead
description: Verifies a visitor can submit the quote form and the app attempts to persist the lead before opening WhatsApp.
steps: Fill name, email, phone, service, budget, and project details
expected: A WhatsApp quote message opens and the submission is written to client_inquiries.
